Overview

Muzaffarabad is a city in Azad Kashmir with a population of 200,000. The capital of Azad Kashmir, a scenic city in the Himalayas known for its rivers and mountain views. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
